review_basis: Complete immutable candidate and baseline Git contents read; candidate UTF8 byte sizes and SHA256 match author pins.
Complete line differences reviewed, consisting of three production substitutions and four reference-based test definitions.
Existing stable_candidates, strip_ext, best_by_import_distance and candidate_count_penalty function regions compared byte-for-byte and unchanged.

findings.result: Original lowercase name, optional lowercase export alias, and conditional default key still form exactly the same set. Default-key duplication is resolved before optional alias equality filtering. Each resulting file/name bucket receives the original symbol index once in original symbol order, including Unicode lowercase expansion and empty alias/name values. Different key insertion order does not enter direct_exports file/name lookup.

Entry allocation, other indices, direct_exports lookup and remove_files are unchanged. Removal really tombstones without reusing slots, so the new reference control's append index symbols.len()+i matches the existing source behavior.

Only the intermediate two segment Vec allocations are removed. Original strip_ext and forward slash splitting, empty components, trailing separators, Unicode, unknown/case-sensitive suffix handling and comparison stopping rule are preserved.

Single traversal retains all candidates at the greatest observed prefix length, preserving their input order, then invokes the unchanged stable_candidates. This retains its existing stable sort and adjacent identity deduplication, including same identity with different qname; no broader dedup, uniqueness or confidence change is introduced.

Read two catalog tests using the original HashSet registration reference (alias/default/Unicode/empty collisions, chunked append, remove/readd/tombstone) and two helpers tests using original Vec-prefix and two-pass selection references (path edge cases and exhaustive candidate sequences length 0..4). No obvious static type/ownership issue found. These controls have not been compiled or executed by this reviewer.

limits: Static source review only; rustfmt, compilation, Clippy and four new Rust control execution remain not_run.
